claimsGrantedOnPass: The seed contains bounded, hash-inventoried starter files, valid task ownership and dependency links, and canonical SDK initialization inputs.
The package initializes into a pointer-only Organization and same-world Workspaces in isolated SDK conformance fixtures.
claimsNeverGranted: Signed estate activation, private Hive membership, federation activation, or authority over a company.
Completed business work, real customers, real financial results, or running agents.
Permission to execute downloaded code or to perform external effects.

requirements.rule: Use only the exact declared SDK and RAPP/1 revisions and verified bytes.
Verify every file's byte count and SHA-256 and the deterministic archive before using it.
An Organization routes through native workspace pointers and never absorbs team contents.
All member workspaces share the organization's world; external partners remain inert discovery references.
Every team owns tasks; inputs resolve to starter files or dependency outputs; the dependency graph is acyclic.
Review and approve each complete native plan and exact digest before scaffolding, registration, or file effects.
A seed remains seed-not-activated; reference files must not be represented as completed tasks.
